# Wintun runtime

Official Wintun 0.14.1 amd64 binary, distributed through the permitted C API.
The prebuilt binary license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt` and installed with
the application.

Pinned DLL SHA-256:

```text
E5DA8447DC2C320EDC0FC52FA01885C103DE8C118481F683643CACC3220DAFCE
```

Downloaded from the official `wintun.net/builds/wintun-0.14.1.zip` archive.
The downloaded DLL's Authenticode status was Valid, signed by WireGuard LLC.
Runtime loading verifies this digest and only searches the application/native
module directory or an explicitly configured absolute `SHUVPN_WINTUN_DLL` path.
